description: Build the depreciation schedule for a stored asset, or price one not in the register, per year or per month, to residual or zero, with the table's rate, life and convention. Periods sum exactly to the base.

asset.description: Asset id such as ASSET-2026-0001, or an exact or partial name. Omit and pass the fields below to price an asset that is not in the register

category.description: Table category code or name, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

cost_minor.description: Cost in MINOR units, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

currency.description: ISO code, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

granularity.description: "year" for one row per period, "month" for the monthly charge. Default "year"

in_service_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset entered use. Defaults to purchase_date

life_years.description: Override the useful life from the table, in years

purchase_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

rate_pct.description: Override the annual percentage from the table

scheme.description: Scheme, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

name: asset_schedule
title: Build a depreciation schedule
